### Time with God - Dec. 8, 2010
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-dec-8-2010-11642390.html
Passage: Hosea 11:8
Points:
- God's character and love remain the same across both the Old and New Testaments.
- Even though Israel repeatedly fell into cycles of sin, God consistently received them back with forgiveness.
- The persistent compassion God extended to Israel is the exact same love He offers believers today.
- Believers can live free from the fear of divine abandonment and focus on loving God in return.

### The Lord's Tender Compassion
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lords-tender-compassion
Passage: Hosea 11:8-12
Points:
- Though Israel deserved total destruction for breaking covenant obedience, God held back the full fury of His wrath.
- God's refusal to destroy Israel like Admah and Zeboiim rested on His sovereign grace rather than their merit.
- The Lord promised to preserve a faithful remnant through exile who would ultimately be restored in Christ.
- Meditating on God's unyielding compassion should comfort believers and inspire sincere obedience out of gratitude.
